name: en-long-06-coast-weekend
input: last weekend we drove up to the coast. the weather was cold but sunny. we walked along the beach for almost two hours and then had fish and chips in a tiny pub. my brother tried to teach the dog to swim, which did not go well. on the way home we stopped in a village called whitby to buy souvenirs. we got back late in the evening and fell asleep on the couch. it was exactly the break i needed.
